target.title: fix(fal): apply request policy to media generation requests
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where users configuring FAL provider request policy for media generation would not have that policy applied to FAL image generation HTTP requests.

## Why This Change Was Made

FAL HTTP config now passes `models.providers.fal.request` into the existing provider HTTP request-policy resolver. This keeps FAL on the shared provider request seam and does not change model parameters, generation parsing, or generated image parsing. Explicit private-network opt-in is now honored from the configured request policy instead of being overridden by a hard-coded deny, while the default remains deny.

## User Impact

FAL media generation requests can now honor configured request headers, proxy/TLS transport settings, and explicit private-network request policy through the existing provider request policy mechanism.

## Evidence

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/fal/image-generation-provider.test.ts` passed: 44 tests.
- `node_modules/.bin/oxfmt --check extensions/fal/http-config.ts extensions/fal/image-generation-provider.test.ts` passed.
- `node scripts/run-oxlint.mjs extensions/fal/http-config.ts extensions/fal/image-generation-provider.test.ts` passed.
- `git diff --check` passed.
- Resolver proof: `resolveFalHttpRequestConfig` with configured `baseUrl`, `request.headers.X-Fal-Trace`, and `request.allowPrivateNetwork: true` returned `allowPrivateNetwork: true` plus the configured header and redacted Authorization header.
- Controlled real provider-path proof, using `buildFalImageGenerationProvider().generateImage()` against a local HTTP server through the normal Fal provider path:

```text
$ FAL_API_KEY=<redacted> node_modules/.bin/tsx --eval '<local Fal-compatible HTTP server + buildFalImageGenerationProvider().generateImage(...) harness>'
{
  "baseUrl": "http://127.0.0.1:<redacted>",
  "requests": [
    {
      "method": "POST",
      "url": "/fal-ai/flux/dev",
      "authorization": "<redacted>",
      "trace": "trace-harness",
      "contentType": "application/json",
      "body": "{\"prompt\":\"draw a local cat\",\"num_images\":1,\"output_format\":\"png\"}"
    },
    {
      "method": "GET",
      "url": "/files/generated.png",
      "body": ""
    }
  ],
  "images": [
    {
      "mimeType": "image/png",
      "fileName": "image-1.png",
      "bytes": 8
    }
  ],
  "metadata": {
    "prompt": "local cat"
  }
}
```

- Not run: live FAL API call.

AI-assisted change.
